description:
The easy way to share photos from any trip or get-together.

Start the event as the trip begins, and everyone's photos land in everyone's library as you go — no waiting until you're home. Scan the QR code to join: your photos flow to the group, and the group's flow to you, right in your Photos app. No group chats, no "can you send me those."

No account. No sign-up. If you can scan a code, you're in — nobody gets left out.

And every photo arrives at full quality, exactly as it was taken — not the shrunk-down version a messaging app sends.

Great for trips and weekends away, weddings, birthdays, and parties — any time a group takes photos and everyone wants them all.
promotionalText: Start an event, share the QR, and everyone's photos land in your library as the trip happens — full quality, no account, no group chats.
